description: Said the loaf wants a finger, and brought the other bill as news she could not read.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Priced the fish and kept him at the table.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat at the far end of the board and did not speak.
name: Gib

description: Paid threepence and stayed at the lodging.
name: William Shakespeare
